title: 早上六点四十五分  (Six Forty-Five)

segments.t: It is six forty-five in the morning at Courtyard Inn in Chengdu. While the guests still sleep upstairs, Chen sketches a quick street map on paper for Qing. Listen to the whole scene first.
老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
跟河水一样凉。把这个坏铜阀门装进外套口袋。
装好了。快告诉我五金店怎么走。
出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
店门外面有大招牌吗？
门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
'Morning, Chen! Is the shower water upstairs really cold already?'
跟河水一样凉。把这个坏铜阀门装进外套口袋。
'Cold as river water. Put this broken brass valve into your coat pocket.'
装好了。快告诉我五金店怎么走。
'Got it in. Now tell me quickly how to get to the hardware shop.'
出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
'Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.'
出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
'Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?'
对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
'Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.'
过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
'Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?'
再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
'Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.'
店门外面有大招牌吗？
'Is there a big shop sign outside the door?'
门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
'Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.'
二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
'Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!'
快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
'Run fast, Qing. Room four wakes up at a quarter past seven!'

Left outside the gate, straight to the stone bridge, past the green pharmacy, and left into the square—Qing is off on her dawn run. See you next time.
回头见！
